source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Where a card mentions a unit leaving the battlefield, that happens when the unit is destroyed, when it goes aboard a TRANSPORT, or when any rule takes it off the battlefield, for instance to put it into strategic reserves.

qualifyingEvents: the unit embarks on a TRANSPORT
any rule removes the unit from the battlefield
detail.example: removal to place the unit in strategic reserves
